_comment: Human verdicts on name/geometry conflicts the join reports. The join always keeps a building
where the 2D map puts it; an entry here records WHY that was right (or wrong) so the report
can show the conflict as reviewed instead of asking again on every run.

O.verifiedAgainst: uploads/SacramentoCampusMap-2025Update-11x17-press.pdf (official UC Davis Health map): RESEARCH 2 north (y=401), RESEARCH 1 middle (y=425), RESEARCH 3 south (y=450)
O.note: OSM labels the middle building 'Research II' and the north one 'Research I'; the official map says 1 and 2. OSM is wrong here. Its addr:housenumber tags (4635 north, 4625 middle, 4645 south) are non-monotonic too, which fits a loose attribution.

Pb.note: North building is Research 2 on the official map; OSM calls it Research I.
